name: Pyramid DFS + Budget-Aware Restart
tagline: Pyramid-shaped DFS that widens at shallow depths, throttles retries as budget shrinks, and restarts from root with accumulated diversity.
init_recovers: DFSDT when widening and throttling are off
diff_from_baseline: Versus DFSDT, adds depth-dependent fanout (more retries near root), budget-aware retry throttling, depth-proportional give-up backtracking, and an outer root-restart loop driven by accumulated diversity prompts.

name: DFSDT + Keyword Pruning + Beam Fallback
tagline: DFSDT-style depth-first expansion with text-based pruning of error-laden observations, plus a shallow beam fallback pass when DFS fails.

key_hyperparams.name: error_keyword_threshold
key_hyperparams.role: min keyword hits to prune leaf

key_hyperparams.name: fallback_width
key_hyperparams.role: shallow nodes expanded in fallback pass

init_recovers: Plain DFSDT when no observation contains ≥2 error keywords
diff_from_baseline: Versus DFSDT, adds lexical observation-quality pruning (≥2 error keywords kills the leaf without recursing) and a second BFS-like fallback pass that re-expands shallow surviving nodes if DFS exits empty.

name: Best-First Frontier (depth − errors)
tagline: Maintains a single frontier of active nodes scored by depth minus accumulated path errors and re-expansion count, expanding the highest scorer each step.

key_hyperparams.name: w_path_errors
key_hyperparams.role: penalty per accumulated error on path

key_hyperparams.name: consecutive_error_kill
key_hyperparams.role: prune leaf after this many in-a-row errors

init_recovers: DFS when path_errors and expand_num stay at 0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces recursive DFSDT with a single global priority queue scored by linear (depth, errors, expansions). Avoids LLM ranking entirely; parents get re-queued until their beam is spent. Adds early kill after 2 consecutive errors.

name: Depth-Adaptive Repair Search
tagline: Heuristic-scored frontier that mostly behaves greedy, widens only at shallow depths, and calls expensive LLM ranking at most once per ambiguous shallow node.

key_hyperparams.name: weights (action, obs_ok, err, prior, fails, trials, repairs, depth, slack)
shallow_widen_depth
key_hyperparams.role: depths that get width 2 on first trial

key_hyperparams.name: rank_depth_cap
key_hyperparams.role: only run LLM ranking at depth ≤4

key_hyperparams.name: rank_budget_floor
key_hyperparams.role: min remaining budget to invoke ranker

init_recovers: Greedy DFS when no widening fires and no ranking is invoked
diff_from_baseline: Versus DFSDT/dfs_ranked, replaces recursion with a heuristic priority queue that progressively widens only near the root, propagates dead-ends to the nearest expandable ancestor, and rationings the LLM pairwise ranker to a single invocation per shallow ambiguous node.

name: DFSDT + Observation-Quality Scoring
tagline: DFSDT that pre-scores each generated child by lightweight observation heuristics (JSON shape, success/error keywords, depth) and recurses into best-first.

key_hyperparams.name: json_dict_bonus
key_hyperparams.role: bonus for valid JSON dict observation

init_recovers: DFSDT when all generated children get equal scores
diff_from_baseline: Versus DFSDT, adds a no-cost local heuristic scorer over each child observation (JSON shape, success/error keyword vocabulary, depth efficiency, status code). Recursion order is best-first by that score; very low-scoring children are pruned outright. Beam halves once half the query budget is spent.
